paite: Huaiziak in Pathian ma leh akilatna leh alalgam a misi leh mihing tung a vai hawm dingpa, Toupa Jesu Khrist ma ah mohpuakna ka hon guan hi.
heading: Paul Leh Pahtakman
english: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

paite: Thu gen in; ahun hi in ahun lou ah leng pang zel in; thuakzoutak a thuhilh kawm in asiamlouhdan uh theisak inla, taihilh inla, hanthawn in,
english: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

paite: thuhilhna dik angaihkhiak ngap louh hun uh ahong tung ding a; abilte uh azau ziak in amau deihlam bang in heutute akiang uah akhawm ding uh;
english: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

paite: abilte uh thutak lam ah angongsak ding ua, tangthu lam naih in apialta ding uhi.
english: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

paite: Nang zaw bangkim ah pilvang in, gimthuak inla, tanchinhoih genna lam nna sem in na nasepna pen hihtangtung in.
english: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

paite: Kei zaw tu in leng luikhiak in ka om lellel a, ka pawt hun atungta hi.
english: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

paite: Douna hoih tuh ka dou khinta a, kitaitehna ka tai khinta, ginna ka lenkip paisuakta hi.
english: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

paite: Tu'n ah zaw kei a ding in Diktatna Lallukhu koih in a-omta, Toupa vaihawmpa diktat in huai ni chiang in kei ahon pe ding, kei kiang kia hilou in akilakna it peuhmahte kiang ah ape sam ding hi.
english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

paite: Kintak in ka kiang a hong pai pah hon tum in; Dema in tulai khovel a-it ziak in hon paisan a,
heading: Mimal Kithuhilhnate
english: Be diligent to come to me soon,

paite: Thessalonika ah apaita hi; Galatia gam ah Kristens apai a, Dalmatia gam ah Titas apaita hi.
english: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

paite: Luka kia ka kiang ah a-om hi. Marka chial inla, hon pi in, amah nasepna lam ah kei a ding in aphatuam hi.
english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

paite: Ephesa ah Taikika ka sawlta.
english: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

paite: Na hong pai chiang in Troas a Karpas kiang a puanaktual ka nutsiat, laibute toh hon tawi in, savun lai mahmah hon tawi in.
english: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

paite: Alexander, dalsun siampa, ka tung ah agilou mahmah hi.
english: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

paite: Toupa'n athilhih bang zel in athuk ding; amah lak ah nang leng pilvang in, i thu adou mahmah hi.
english: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

paite: Ka siamna thu ka gen masakpen in kuama'n ahon gum kei ua, ahon zuausan vek uhi; amoh pua in om tuan kei uhen.
english: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

paite: Tanchinhoih keimah ziak a hilhkim a a-omtheihna ding leh Zentelte'n azaktheihna ding un, Toupa'n hon gum a ahon hihhat zawta hi; humpinelkai kam a kipan in suahtaksak in ka omta hi.
english: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

paite: Toupa'n gitlouhna tengteng lak a kipan in ahon suaktasak dia, avan-gam ah bittak in ahon tun ding; ama kiang ah tangtawn in thupina om hen. Amen.
english: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Priscilla leh Akuila, Onesiphoras inkuanpihte toh, chibai hon buksak in.
heading: Chibai Bukna Nanungte
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

paite: Korinth ah Erastas a-om gige a, Trophimas bel Melita ah damlou in ka nusia hi.
english: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

paite: Phalbi ma in hong pai teitei in, Iubalas, Pudens, Linas, Klaudia leh unau tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist in na kha ompih hen. Na kiang ah hehpihna om hen. Amen.
english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
